app.name: A4 Label Sheet
gui.text_frame: 2  Text labels (one per line; wraps and sizes automatically)
gui.advanced_frame: 4  Label preset & grid (adjust only when changing stock)
gui.hint.text: Tip: one line = one label. End a line with |2 or ×2 to print that label twice (e.g. URGENT A-01 |2). Leave empty to use PDF cards only.
gui.align.label: Align:
gui.text_uniform: Uniform font size (use the smallest size that fits, for a tidier look)
gui.preset.label: Preset:
gui.preset.hint: (selecting a preset fills the grid below; you can still edit it)
gui.lang.label: 语言 / Language
gui.status.ready: Ready: add a PDF or paste text below, then click “Generate”
gui.warn.no_pdf: No PDFs found in those paths.
gui.warn.no_content: Nothing to do: add a PDF, or paste a few lines into the text box.
gui.err.grid_number: A grid value is not a number: {error}
gui.err.grid_positive: Columns and rows must be greater than 0.
cli.description: {app} {version} — turn PDF page regions or plain text into A4 label sheets
cli.help.inputs: PDF, folder, or ZIP (multiple allowed; optional when using text labels only)
cli.help.out: Output folder (default: “label-output” next to the first PDF)
cli.help.name: Output filename prefix (default: label)
cli.help.preset: Label preset (default: “{default}”; use --list-presets to list all)
cli.help.list_presets: List all label presets and exit
cli.help.save_config: Save the current grid parameters as JSON
cli.help.cell: Cell width x height in mm, e.g. 40x30
cli.help.pitch: Pitch width x height in mm, e.g. 41.5x32
cli.help.first_page_only: Use only page 1 of each PDF
cli.help.text: Add a text label (repeatable); end with |2 to print it twice
cli.help.text_file: Read text labels from a file (one per line)
cli.help.text_uniform: Use one font size for all text labels (the smallest that fits), for a tidier look
cli.help.no_proof: Do not generate the knife-line proof
cli.help.no_csv: Do not generate the label list CSV
cli.help.lang: UI language: zh or en (default: system language; English for other locales)
cli.err.no_input: No input: pass PDFs / folders / ZIPs, or use --text / --text-file.
parser.warn.no_anchor: Page {page}: no “文件名称” card found; skipped
parser.warn.no_fields: Page {page}, row {row}, col {col}: possible card, but field lines were not found; skipped
parser.warn.no_name: Page {page}, row {row}, col {col}: possible card, but no name could be read; skipped
parser.warn.no_content: Page {page}, “{name}”: no content area found; skipped
parser.warn.bad_box: Page {page}, “{name}”: content area is invalid; skipped
builder.err.empty: Nothing to lay out: provide a PDF, or paste a few lines into the text box
builder.log.place: Laying out {total} sticker(s) (PDF {pdf} + text {text}) on {sheets} sheet(s) → {file}
